versions.changelog:
verified-agent-identity v1.0.0

- Initial release of the Billions decentralized identity skill for agents
- Enables agents to create, manage, and link Billions DIDs to human identities via ERC-8004 and attestation registries
- Provides scripts for identity creation, challenge/response, linking, and verification
- Stores all identity data under $HOME/.openclaw/billions for OpenClaw compatibility
- Enforces strict operational and security guardrails to protect private keys and prevent manual cryptographic manipulation
